localElectionsBody: FILL or null: who runs local elections, if not the national body
notice: FILL: e.g. Citizen-verified tallies. Only <short name> declares results.
elections: FILL: path to elections.json (dates from the electoral body, with source URLs)

geography.admin1: FILL: TopoJSON (geoBoundaries ADM1 works for every African country)
geography.pollingUnitCode: FILL: regex for the official polling-station code

pollingUnits.totalSource: FILL: source of the national polling-station count
pollingUnits.codePattern: FILL: regex for the official polling-station code

statePrefix.FILL two-digit prefix: FILL ISO 3166-2 code of the admin-1 area, e.g. XX-AB

parties: FILL: party register with source URL
races: FILL: races.json (which offices, which areas vote)
resultForm: FILL: name of the posted polling-station result form

winning.FILL race: FILL: constitutional/legal rule with article number

baselines: FILL: registered voters per area, with source and fetch timestamp
